# ReadmeCraft

> ReadmeCraft is a free, open-source, browser-based GitHub Profile README Builder and Generator. It allows software engineers, developers, and open-source creators to design, preview, and publish customized GitHub profile READMEs in real time with zero server storage.

## Core Capabilities

- [Live GitHub Simulation](https://readmecraft.github.io/#features): Side-by-side split screen preview supporting official GitHub Dark (#0d1117) and Light (#ffffff) color palettes, plus a 375px mobile viewport toggle.
- [65+ Tech Stack Badges](https://readmecraft.github.io/#skills): Searchable icons across Languages, Frontend, Backend, Databases, Cloud & DevOps, and Tools. Supports Shields.io badges, Devicons vector logos, and minimal markdown bullet points.
- [23+ Social & Coding Profiles](https://readmecraft.github.io/#features): Badges with authentic brand colors and vector SVG logos for GitHub, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, YouTube, Dev.to, Medium, Discord, Buy Me a Coffee, and more.
- [Dynamic Stats Integration](https://readmecraft.github.io/#features): Live stats cards, streak stats counters, and top languages graphs via GitHub Readme Stats and GitHub Readme Streak Stats.
- [ASCII Art Banners](https://readmecraft.github.io/#features): Monospace ASCII text banner generator and image-to-ASCII converter with customizable character sets and width constraints.
- [1-Click GitHub Publishing](https://readmecraft.github.io/#features): Directly commits the generated README.md to the user's special username/username repository via the GitHub REST API.
- [100% Client-Side Privacy](https://readmecraft.github.io/#privacy): Runs completely in the browser. Personal Access Tokens are held exclusively in volatile RAM and purged immediately after execution. Fully compliant with India's DPDP Act 2023 and GDPR.

## Documentation & URLs

- [ReadmeCraft Homepage](https://readmecraft.github.io/): Main web application and documentation portal.
- [Interactive Editor](https://readmecraft.github.io/editor.html): Live README editor with real-time preview and export tools.
- [Full LLM Specification](https://readmecraft.github.io/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical details and schema reference for AI agents.
- [XML Sitemap](https://readmecraft.github.io/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all website URLs and canonical locations.
- [Privacy Policy](https://readmecraft.github.io/privacy.html): DPDP and GDPR compliant data processing and privacy terms.
- [Terms of Service](https://readmecraft.github.io/terms.html): Open-source MIT usage terms and client-side operating conditions.
- [Cookie Policy](https://readmecraft.github.io/cookies.html): Notice of zero persistent tracking cookies and client-side state.
- [Source Code Repository](https://github.com/readmecraft/readmecraft.github.io): GitHub repository holding the complete open-source codebase.

## Quickstart Guide

- [Launch Editor](https://readmecraft.github.io/editor.html): Open the online builder directly.
- [Choose a Role Template](https://readmecraft.github.io/#templates): Select from Minimal, Developer, Open Source, Freelancer, or Creator templates.
- [Review Developer Playbook](https://readmecraft.github.io/#guide): Senior engineer best practices for building an impactful profile.
